def solve(facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]; ix={v:i for i,v in enumerate(ids)}
    pred=[sum(1<<ix[x] for x in j['predecessors']) for j in jobs]
    best=None
    def rec(mask,t,order,starts,cost):
        nonlocal best
        if mask==(1<<n)-1:
            key=(cost,t,tuple(ids[i] for i in order))
            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,order[:],starts[:])
            return
        for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
            bit=1<<i
            if mask&bit or pred[i]&mask!=pred[i]: continue
            s=max(t,j['release']); c=s+j['duration']; nc=cost+j['weight']*max(0,c-j['due'])
            if best is not None and nc>best[0][0]: continue
            rec(mask|bit,c,order+[i],starts+[s],nc)
    rec(0,0,[],[],0)
    key,order,starts=best
    return {'order':[ids[i] for i in order],'starts':starts,'finish':key[1],'weighted_tardiness':key[0]}
def check(answer,facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]; ix={v:i for i,v in enumerate(ids)}
    if not isinstance(answer,dict) or set(answer.keys())!={'order','starts','finish','weighted_tardiness'}: return False
    order=answer['order']; starts=answer['starts']
    if len(order)!=n or len(starts)!=n or set(order)!=set(ids): return False
    t=0; mask=set(); cost=0
    for k,name in enumerate(order):
        if name not in ix: return False
        j=jobs[ix[name]]
        if any(p not in mask for p in j['predecessors']): return False
        s=max(t,j['release'])
        if starts[k]!=s: return False
        t=s+j['duration']; cost+=j['weight']*max(0,t-j['due']); mask.add(name)
    if answer['finish']!=t or answer['weighted_tardiness']!=cost: return False
    # Independently enumerate every feasible sequence to certify all tie-breaks.
    optimum=None
    def visit(done,tm,seq,cc):
        nonlocal optimum
        if len(seq)==n:
            key=(cc,tm,tuple(seq))
            if optimum is None or key<optimum: optimum=key
            return
        for j in jobs:
            name=j['id']
            if name in done or any(p not in done for p in j['predecessors']): continue
            end=max(tm,j['release'])+j['duration']
            visit(done|{name},end,seq+[name],cc+j['weight']*max(0,end-j['due']))
    visit(set(),0,[],0)
    return (cost,t,tuple(order))==optimum
